svg.text: Two designs for marking a season, drawn on the same two cards
A: a 48 px sign beside the kicker. B: a 160 px emblem in the top right corner, as the church packs do. Red boxes are the mark's rectangle.
Serif italic, Christmas: A the sign, 48 px
covers nothing: the mark's rectangle meets no other drawn element
Serif italic, Christmas: B the emblem, 160 px
covers: kicker_right, rule
Liturgy, Easter: A the sign, 56 px
covers nothing: the mark's rectangle meets no other drawn element
Liturgy, Easter: B the emblem, 160 px
covers nothing: the mark's rectangle meets no other drawn element
Share of the sheet: A 0.111%, B 1.235%.
B's top right rectangle lands on a drawn element in 15 of 17 families (free only in d2 and d11), its bottom right one inside the body area in 17 of 17; A meets nothing in the four wireframes.
Where B fits (d11's empty corner, drawn here) it is a poster, not a data card; A takes 72 px of one existing line, which the kicker already gives up when it is too long.
Recommended: A. B stays as the size for a gallery tile or a title-only card with no table (the church packs' posters carry no data).
